schemaChanges: Added armament.attackPatterns to preserve AND/OR printed attack alternatives.
Added capacity.carriedCraftConfigurations for mutually exclusive vehicle-carriage alternatives.
Added systems.capabilityModeGroups for variable organic and other subsystems.
Added conditionalAttackModifiers and firingCountPrinted on weaponMount without inferring physical weapon count.
Added rule.effects typed mechanical operation declarations and per-turn action limits.
Separated printed batteries/attack groups from inferred physical weapon mount counts.
Separated printed gunner/pilot roles from unverified crew station keys.
Added role-specific cover modifiers for X-wing astromech +5.
Added explicit dual-category droid-vehicle classification and source representation labels.
Removed category-based inference of inapplicable hyperdrive; source-specific field states only.
Kept every common field across all fixtures; categories do not filter schemas.
unresolvedDesignIssues: Typed predicate grammar for conditions is not yet frozen: string conditions are auditable but not executable.
Canonical vehicle weapon definition keys require Phase 1 identity reconciliation, not arbitrary name matching.
Published weapon attack modifiers are crew-statblock values, not reusable intrinsic weapon bonuses.
Source labels and a selected numeric page are validated, but all six records are explicitly non-certified.
The draft schema does not guarantee field-state completeness or logical cross-field consistency without supplemental checks.
Advanced vehicle mechanics require a formal operation vocabulary and runtime consumer mapping before implementation.
weaponAuthorityFixtureCoverage: not-performed: independent intrinsic weapon claims require separate identity reconciliation
certificationGatesNotMet: Full primary-source line-by-line transcription review for each record (Phase 2+).
Typed operational predicate grammar and special-rule semantics, including Coralskipper, Golan and DP-2.
Separate intrinsic weapon authority and canonical weapon identity verification.
Publication/variant identity reconciliation and cross-book conflicts.
Full corpus stress testing beyond these six deliberately challenging samples.
Certification-grade field-status audit of nulls within variable-length nested arrays.
